lines.text: Good morning, welcome to the Harborview Hotel. How can I help you?
Hi, I have a reservation under Daniel Price. I know check-in isn't until three, but my flight got in early, and I was hoping to get into my room.
Let me check... I'm sorry, Mr. Price, housekeeping is still cleaning the room. It should be ready around one o'clock.
That's fine. I have a client meeting downtown at eleven anyway. Is there somewhere I can leave my suitcase?
Of course. We can keep it behind the desk, and I'll text you as soon as your room is available.
Perfect. Could you also tell me the quickest way to get to Bay Street?
The tram stop is right across the road. Take line 4, and it's three stops.

questions.q: Where does the conversation most likely take place?
questions.explain: Người phụ nữ chào: "welcome to the Harborview Hotel" và người đàn ông nói về giờ nhận phòng (check-in), nên đây là khách sạn.

questions.q: Why can't the man get into his room now?
options: The room is still being prepared
questions.explain: Lễ tân nói: "housekeeping is still cleaning the room" – phòng vẫn đang được dọn.

questions.q: What will the woman do for the man?
options: Notify him when his room is ready
questions.explain: Cô ấy nói: "I'll text you as soon as your room is available" – sẽ nhắn tin báo khi phòng sẵn sàng.

lines.text: Linda, are the quarterly sales figures ready? I need them for the board presentation this afternoon.
Almost. The regional managers sent their numbers late, so I'm still combining everything into one spreadsheet.
The meeting starts at two. Do you think you'll make it?
Well, the Northern office hasn't sent anything yet.
Hmm. I'll call Greg up there and ask him to send their data right away.
That would help a lot. Once I have it, I just need about half an hour to finish the charts.
Great. And when you're done, could you email the file directly to me instead of putting it on the shared drive? I want to check it before the others see it.

questions.q: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
questions.explain: Người đàn ông hỏi: "are the quarterly sales figures ready?" – họ bàn về báo cáo doanh số quý.

questions.q: What does the woman imply when she says, "Well, the Northern office hasn't sent anything yet"?
options: She will visit the Northern office
She may not finish on time
questions.explain: Khi được hỏi có kịp không, cô ấy nói văn phòng miền Bắc chưa gửi số liệu – ngụ ý có thể không xong kịp giờ họp.

questions.q: What does the man ask the woman to do?
options: Send the completed file to him
Upload the charts to a shared folder
questions.explain: Anh ấy nói: "could you email the file directly to me" – gửi file trực tiếp cho anh ấy.

lines.text: Hi, we'd like to book a table for our team dinner next Friday. There'll be about twelve of us.
Next Friday... our main dining room is fully booked, but our private room upstairs is available. It seats up to fourteen.
That might actually be better. It's a farewell party for a colleague, and we're planning to give a short speech.
Then the private room is ideal. There's a minimum spend of six hundred dollars, though, and we'd need a deposit to hold it.
Raj, is that within our budget?
It should be. The department set aside about eight hundred.
Wonderful. I'll email you the set menu options so everyone can choose in advance.
Great, and I'll pay the deposit by card right now.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the dinner?
options: To say goodbye to a coworker
questions.explain: Raj nói: "It's a farewell party for a colleague" – tiệc chia tay đồng nghiệp.

questions.q: What does the woman say about the private room?
options: It has a view of the river
Guests must spend a minimum amount
questions.explain: Cô ấy nói: "There's a minimum spend of six hundred dollars" – phải chi tiêu tối thiểu.

questions.q: What will Tom most likely do next?
questions.explain: Tom nói: "I'll pay the deposit by card right now" – anh ấy sẽ trả tiền đặt cọc.

graphic.title: Copy Paper Prices – Brightline Office Supply

lines.text: Victor, we're almost out of copy paper again. I was going to order more from Brightline this morning.
Good idea. How many boxes do we usually get?
Fifteen, but we keep running out before the end of the month. Since the training sessions started, everyone's been printing handouts.
Then let's order more at once. It's cheaper per box, too. Do we have room in the storage closet?
If we move the old monitors out, we could fit about thirty.
Let's do thirty, then. I'll ask the IT team to collect the monitors today.
Great, I'll place the order after lunch.

questions.q: What problem does the woman mention?
options: The office keeps running short of a supply
questions.explain: Cô ấy nói: "we're almost out of copy paper again" và "we keep running out" – văn phòng thường xuyên hết giấy.

questions.q: According to the woman, why has more paper been used recently?
options: A new client asked for printed reports
Handouts are being printed for training
questions.explain: Cô ấy nói: "Since the training sessions started, everyone's been printing handouts."

questions.q: Look at the graphic. How much will the company most likely pay per box?
questions.explain: Họ quyết định đặt "thirty" (30 hộp), thuộc mức 20–49 hộp nên giá là $26 mỗi hộp.

lines.text: Ms. Walsh? This is Jason from Riverside Auto. I'm calling about your car.
Oh, hi. Is it ready? I was hoping to pick it up after work.
Well, we finished the oil change, but while it was on the lift, we noticed the front brake pads are quite worn.
Is it dangerous to drive?
Not immediately, but I'd recommend replacing them within the next month. We could do it today for about a hundred and eighty dollars, including labor.
Hmm, I'd rather not leave the car another day. I need it for a trip this weekend.
The part's in stock, so it would only take an extra hour. It'd still be ready by five.
In that case, go ahead.

questions.q: Who most likely is the man?
questions.explain: Anh ấy gọi từ "Riverside Auto" và nói đã thay dầu, kiểm tra phanh – anh ấy là thợ sửa xe.

questions.q: What problem does the man report?
options: A part is out of stock
The oil change was not completed
questions.explain: Anh ấy nói: "the front brake pads are quite worn" – má phanh bị mòn.

questions.q: What does the woman agree to do?
options: Rent a car for the weekend
questions.explain: Khi biết chỉ mất thêm một tiếng, cô ấy nói: "In that case, go ahead" – đồng ý thay má phanh luôn.

lines.text: Peter, did you hear the client from Osaka moved their video call up to ten o'clock?
Ten? I thought it was this afternoon. I haven't even tested the new conference room equipment yet.
I know. Facilities only installed the projector yesterday.
And I still need to update the slides with last week's survey results.
I can take care of the slides if you send me the data. You focus on the equipment.
Really? Don't you have your own deadline today?
The budget review? To be honest, it can wait until tomorrow.
Thanks, Nadia. I'll forward the survey results now and head to the conference room.

questions.q: What are the speakers preparing for?
options: An online meeting with a client
questions.explain: Cô ấy nói khách hàng ở Osaka đã dời "their video call" lên 10 giờ – họ chuẩn bị cuộc gọi video với khách hàng.

questions.q: Why does the man say, "I haven't even tested the new conference room equipment yet"?
options: To complain about the Facilities team
To explain why a projector broke
To express concern about being ready
questions.explain: Cuộc gọi bị dời sớm hơn mà anh ấy chưa thử thiết bị – anh ấy lo không kịp chuẩn bị.

questions.q: What does the woman offer to do?
questions.explain: Cô ấy nói: "I can take care of the slides if you send me the data" – cô ấy sẽ cập nhật bài trình chiếu.

lines.text: Kevin, this is Hannah. She's joining the design team today. Is her laptop set up?
Nice to meet you, Hannah. The laptop's ready, but your account won't be active until the HR system processes your contract. That usually takes a few hours.
So I can't log in at all this morning?
Not with your own account. But I can give you a temporary guest login so you can at least read the onboarding documents.
That works. Hannah, the orientation session is at eleven in Room 5B anyway, so you won't need much before then.
Great. Will I need the design software for this week?
Yes, I'll install it this afternoon once your account is active. Just leave the laptop at my desk after lunch.

questions.q: Who most likely is Hannah?
questions.explain: Luis giới thiệu: "She's joining the design team today" – Hannah là nhân viên mới.

questions.q: Why can't Hannah use her own account yet?
options: Some paperwork has not been processed
questions.explain: Kevin nói tài khoản chưa hoạt động "until the HR system processes your contract" – hợp đồng chưa được xử lý.

questions.q: What is Hannah asked to do after lunch?
questions.explain: Kevin nói: "Just leave the laptop at my desk after lunch."

lines.text: Sam, the workshop in Westbridge starts at ten thirty, right? Which train should we take?
I was going to suggest the eight fifteen express, but I have a call with the printing company at eight thirty.
How long will that take?
Fifteen minutes at most. I could do it from home before we leave.
Then there's no need to rush. Let's take the next express after your call. It gets us there with ten minutes to spare.
Sounds good. Should I buy the tickets online?
Yes, please, and get return tickets too. The workshop finishes at four.
Will do. I'll book them right after the call.

questions.q: Where are the speakers going?
questions.explain: Cô ấy hỏi: "the workshop in Westbridge starts at ten thirty, right?" – họ đi dự hội thảo.

questions.q: Why can't the man take the earliest train?
options: He needs to pick up some materials
He has a phone call scheduled
He lives far from the station
questions.explain: Anh ấy nói: "I have a call with the printing company at eight thirty."

questions.q: Look at the graphic. Which train will the speakers most likely take?
questions.explain: Họ đi chuyến "next express" sau cuộc gọi (kết thúc khoảng 8:45) và đến sớm 10 phút trước 10:30 – đó là Express 218, đến lúc 10:20.

lines.text: Hi, Mr. Lee, it's Grace Kim in apartment 4C. The heating in my bedroom stopped working last night.
Oh, I'm sorry to hear that. Is it just the bedroom, or the whole apartment?
Just the bedroom. The radiator's completely cold, but the living room is fine.
It might be air trapped in the pipes. That happens a lot when the weather first turns cold.
Can someone come take a look? I work from home, so I'm in all day.
Our maintenance technician is fixing a leak on the second floor this morning. I'll send him up around two.
That's great, thanks.
In the meantime, there's a portable heater in the storage room. I'll bring it up to you.

questions.q: Who most likely is the man?
questions.explain: Người thuê nhà gọi báo sự cố và anh ấy cử "Our maintenance technician" đến – anh ấy là quản lý tòa nhà.

questions.q: What problem does the woman report?
options: A heating unit is not working
questions.explain: Cô ấy nói: "The heating in my bedroom stopped working" và "The radiator's completely cold".

questions.q: What does the man say he will do?
options: Move the woman to another unit
questions.explain: Anh ấy nói: "there's a portable heater... I'll bring it up to you" – cho mượn máy sưởi di động.

lines.text: Rachel, I just got the floor plan for the Home Tech trade show. Our booth is in Hall C, right at the back.
Hall C? That's where the food stands are. Visitors usually go there just to grab lunch.
That's what worries me. Last year we were by the main entrance and had over three hundred visitors.
Did you ask the organizers if anything else is available?
They said a spot near the entrance opened up, but it costs an extra fifteen hundred dollars.
Fifteen hundred dollars is nothing compared to the orders we got last year.
True. I'll check with finance before the end of the day, then.
And let's make sure we bring enough product samples. We ran out on the second day last time.

questions.q: What event are the speakers discussing?
questions.explain: Anh ấy nói: "the floor plan for the Home Tech trade show" – họ bàn về hội chợ thương mại.

questions.q: What does the woman mean when she says, "Fifteen hundred dollars is nothing compared to the orders we got last year"?
options: The better location is worth the cost
The organizers made a billing error
questions.explain: Năm ngoái gian hàng gần lối vào mang lại nhiều đơn hàng, nên cô ấy ngụ ý trả thêm 1.500 đô cho vị trí tốt là đáng.

questions.q: What does the woman suggest?
questions.explain: Cô ấy nói: "let's make sure we bring enough product samples" vì năm ngoái bị hết mẫu.

lines.text: Hello, I have a two-thirty appointment with Dr. Song for a cleaning. The name's Arthur Bell.
Hi, Mr. Bell. Oh, I'm afraid Dr. Song had to leave early for a family emergency. Didn't you get our message?
No, I've been in meetings all day. I took the afternoon off for this.
I'm very sorry. Julia, does Dr. Ortiz have any openings this afternoon?
Let me see... She has a cancellation at three fifteen. Would that work, Mr. Bell?
That's fine, as long as I'm done by four thirty. I have to pick up my daughter.
A cleaning usually takes about forty-five minutes, so you'll be fine.
While you wait, could you update your insurance details on this form? The policy we have on file has expired.

questions.q: Where most likely are the speakers?
questions.explain: Anh ấy có lịch hẹn với "Dr. Song for a cleaning" (cạo vôi răng) – đây là phòng khám nha khoa.

questions.q: Why is Dr. Song unavailable?
options: She had to deal with a personal matter
questions.explain: Lễ tân nói: "Dr. Song had to leave early for a family emergency" – có việc gia đình khẩn cấp.

questions.q: What is the man asked to do?
questions.explain: Megan nói: "could you update your insurance details on this form?" – điền vào mẫu đơn.

lines.text: Diane, I need to book a room for Thursday's meeting with the Singapore team. They'll be joining by video.
How many people will be in the room on our side?
Eight from our office, maybe nine if Mr. Hughes can make it.
Then you'll need something bigger than Maple. And for a video call you'll want the right equipment.
Definitely. Last time we used a projector and a laptop camera, and the other side couldn't hear us at all.
I know the room you need. I'll reserve it for you now. What time?
Nine to eleven. Could you also order coffee for the room? It's an early start for us.
Sure, I'll call catering after I make the booking.

questions.q: What is the man planning?
options: A meeting with an overseas team
questions.explain: Anh ấy nói: "Thursday's meeting with the Singapore team. They'll be joining by video."

questions.q: What problem does the man mention about a previous meeting?
questions.explain: Anh ấy nói lần trước "the other side couldn't hear us at all" – bên kia không nghe được.

questions.q: Look at the graphic. Which room will the woman most likely reserve?
questions.explain: Cần phòng cho 8–9 người và có thiết bị họp video tốt (không dùng máy chiếu) – chỉ phòng Birch có "Video conference system".

lines.text: Hi, I'd like to cancel my membership. I'm moving to another city next month.
I'm sorry to hear you're leaving. May I ask where you're moving to?
Denver. My company is transferring me to its regional office there.
Actually, we have two locations in Denver. You could transfer your membership instead of canceling it, and keep your current rate.
Really? I didn't know that. I joined during a promotion, so my rate's pretty low.
Exactly. New members there pay about twenty dollars more per month.
Then I'd definitely rather transfer. What do I need to do?
Just fill out this transfer request and give us your new address. It takes about a week to process.

questions.q: Why did the woman come to the gym?
options: To sign up for a class
questions.explain: Cô ấy nói: "I'd like to cancel my membership" – muốn hủy thẻ hội viên.

questions.q: Why is the woman moving?
options: She found a job at another company
She is going back to school
questions.explain: Cô ấy nói: "My company is transferring me to its regional office there" – công ty điều chuyển cô ấy.

questions.q: What does the man ask the woman to provide?
questions.explain: Anh ấy nói: "fill out this transfer request and give us your new address".

lines.text: Ivan, how's the testing going on the new customer portal? We're supposed to launch on Monday.
Mostly fine, but there's a problem with the payment page. On some mobile phones, the confirm button doesn't appear.
That's serious. Customers can't complete a purchase without it.
I know. The developers think it's a display issue with older browsers. They're working on a fix now.
Will it be ready by Monday?
They said it should be, but they also said that last time.
Okay, then let's have a backup plan. If it isn't fixed by Friday afternoon, we'll delay the launch by a week.
Agreed. I'll let the customer service team know so they're ready to answer questions either way.

questions.q: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
questions.explain: Cô ấy hỏi về việc kiểm thử "the new customer portal" sắp ra mắt – một cổng thông tin (website) mới cho khách hàng.

questions.q: Why does the man say, "they also said that last time"?
options: He doubts the developers will meet the deadline
He is confident the work will be done
He wants to hire different developers
questions.explain: Lần trước nhóm lập trình hứa rồi nhưng không làm kịp, nên anh ấy nghi ngờ họ sẽ xong trước thứ Hai.

questions.q: What will the man do next?
questions.explain: Anh ấy nói: "I'll let the customer service team know" – báo cho bộ phận chăm sóc khách hàng.

lines.text: So this is the space. It's about two hundred square meters, and as you can see, there's lots of natural light.
It's bigger than I expected. Alan, what do you think?
I like it, but we only have fifteen staff right now. We'd be paying for a lot of empty space.
We're planning to hire at least ten more people next year, though.
And the owner is open to a three-year lease with reduced rent for the first twelve months.
That would make a difference. Is parking included?
There are six reserved spaces, and the public garage next door offers monthly passes.
Could you send us the lease terms in writing? We'd like to go over them with our accountant.

questions.q: Who most likely is the woman?
questions.explain: Cô ấy dẫn hai người xem văn phòng và nói về điều kiện của "the owner" – cô ấy là môi giới bất động sản.

questions.q: What concern does Alan raise?
options: The space may be larger than needed
questions.explain: Alan nói: "We'd be paying for a lot of empty space" – văn phòng có thể quá rộng so với nhu cầu.

questions.q: What does Steve request?
questions.explain: Steve nói: "Could you send us the lease terms in writing?"

lines.text: Hi, this is Mark Dunn from Allied Consulting. I placed a lunch order for our seminar tomorrow, and I'd like to make a change.
Of course, Mr. Dunn. I have your order here. What would you like to change?
We just found out that more of our attendees are vegetarian than we thought. Could we add ten more of the vegetarian item?
Certainly. Would you like to reduce the chicken sandwiches by the same amount?
Yes, please. The total number of guests hasn't changed.
No problem. Your delivery is still scheduled for eleven thirty, correct?
Actually, could it come a little earlier? The morning session might finish at eleven fifteen.
I'll ask our driver to arrive by eleven.

questions.q: Why is the man calling?
questions.explain: Anh ấy nói: "I placed a lunch order... and I'd like to make a change" – muốn sửa đơn hàng.

questions.q: Why does the man want to make a change?
options: More guests do not eat meat
questions.explain: Anh ấy nói: "more of our attendees are vegetarian than we thought" – nhiều khách ăn chay hơn dự kiến.

questions.q: Look at the graphic. How many vegetable wraps will the man's order now include?
questions.explain: Đơn ban đầu có 20 vegetable wraps (món chay), anh ấy muốn "add ten more" nên tổng cộng là 30.

lines.text: Hi, I'm checking in for the flight to Toronto. Here's my passport.
Thank you, Mr. Haddad. Are you checking any bags today?
Just this one suitcase. And I'd like an aisle seat if possible.
Let me see. The flight's quite full, but there's an aisle seat in row 32, near the back.
That's fine. My connection in Toronto is tight, though. I only have fifty minutes.
In that case, would you prefer an aisle seat closer to the front? There's one in an exit row for a forty-dollar fee.
Yes, I'll take that. It'll help me get off the plane quickly.
All right. Your suitcase will be checked through to your final destination, so you won't need to collect it in Toronto.

questions.q: Where does the conversation most likely take place?
questions.explain: Người đàn ông nói: "I'm checking in for the flight to Toronto" và đưa hộ chiếu – đây là quầy làm thủ tục ở sân bay.

questions.q: What is the man worried about?
options: He might miss a connecting flight
questions.explain: Anh ấy nói: "My connection in Toronto is tight... I only have fifty minutes" – sợ lỡ chuyến nối.

questions.q: What does the man agree to do?
questions.explain: Anh ấy đồng ý ghế ở hàng thoát hiểm "for a forty-dollar fee": "Yes, I'll take that."

lines.text: Lucas, I've scheduled the final interviews for the accountant position. Three candidates are coming in on Wednesday.
Thanks, Sarah. Who's first?
Ms. Patel, at nine. She's the one with ten years of experience at a large firm.
Her résumé is impressive. But I'm a little concerned about the salary she's asking for.
She did mention she'd be flexible if we could offer remote work two days a week.
Well, half the team already works from home on Fridays.
So that might be an option, then. Should I let her know before the interview?
No, let's discuss it in person. Could you print a copy of our current remote work policy for the interview?

questions.q: What position are the speakers trying to fill?
questions.explain: Cô ấy nói: "the final interviews for the accountant position" – vị trí kế toán.

questions.q: What does the man imply when he says, "half the team already works from home on Fridays"?
questions.explain: Ứng viên muốn làm từ xa; anh ấy nói nhiều người đã làm ở nhà rồi – ngụ ý có thể đáp ứng yêu cầu đó.

questions.q: What does the man ask the woman to do?
questions.explain: Anh ấy nói: "Could you print a copy of our current remote work policy" – chuẩn bị một tài liệu.

lines.text: Tony, the shipment for Greenleaf Markets was supposed to leave this morning. The client just called asking where it is.
We had it packed, but the truck broke down on the way here. The transport company is sending a replacement.
When will it get here?
Jacob's been talking to them. Jacob?
They said around three. So the delivery would reach Greenleaf at about seven this evening.
Their store closes at six, though. Nobody will be there to receive it.
Then I'll arrange a morning delivery. They can have it by eight tomorrow, before they open.
Okay. I'll call the client back and explain, and maybe offer free shipping on their next order.

questions.q: What problem are the speakers discussing?
questions.explain: Erica nói lô hàng "was supposed to leave this morning" nhưng chưa đi – hàng bị giao trễ.

questions.q: What caused the problem?
questions.explain: Tony nói: "the truck broke down on the way here" – xe tải bị hỏng.

questions.q: What does Erica plan to do?
options: Get in touch with the client
questions.explain: Erica nói: "I'll call the client back and explain" – gọi lại cho khách hàng.

lines.text: Greg, are you going to any of the sessions in Room B today?
I was planning to attend the one on brand stories, but my manager asked me to meet a supplier at ten.
That's too bad. I heard the speaker is excellent.
I know. Are they recording the sessions?
Only the keynotes, I think. But she's giving the same talk in Chicago next month.
Oh well. Actually, I'm more interested in the one on data-driven advertising. Our team is just starting to use analytics.
Then let's go to that one together. I'll save you a seat.
Thanks. I'll text you when my meeting's over.

questions.q: Where most likely are the speakers?
questions.explain: Họ nói về các "sessions in Room B", diễn giả và bài phát biểu chính (keynotes) – đây là một hội nghị.

questions.q: Why will the man miss the session on brand stories?
options: He will be traveling to Chicago
He has a meeting with a supplier
questions.explain: Anh ấy nói: "my manager asked me to meet a supplier at ten" – trùng giờ gặp nhà cung cấp.

questions.q: Look at the graphic. What time will the speakers most likely attend a session together?
questions.explain: Họ sẽ cùng đi phiên "data-driven advertising"; theo bảng, phiên Data-Driven Advertising bắt đầu lúc 1:00.

lines.text: Hello, I'm here to pick up a suit. The name's Wilson.
Mr. Wilson... yes, the gray suit. We shortened the sleeves and took in the jacket at the waist. Would you like to try it on?
Sure... Hmm, the sleeves are perfect, but the jacket feels a bit tight across the shoulders.
I see what you mean. We only adjusted the waist, but that may have pulled the shoulders in. I can let it out slightly.
How long would that take? I need it for a wedding on Saturday.
We could have it ready by Thursday afternoon. And there'd be no extra charge, of course.
Thursday works. Could you also press the trousers when you're done?
Absolutely. I'll write it on the ticket now.

questions.q: Who most likely is the woman?
questions.explain: Cô ấy nói: "We shortened the sleeves and took in the jacket" – cô ấy là thợ may sửa đồ.

questions.q: What problem does the man mention?
options: The jacket does not fit well
The suit is the wrong color
questions.explain: Anh ấy nói: "the jacket feels a bit tight across the shoulders" – áo khoác hơi chật.

questions.q: What does the man request?
questions.explain: Anh ấy nhờ thêm: "Could you also press the trousers" – ủi quần, một dịch vụ bổ sung.

lines.text: Hugo, did you see the email about the new parking policy? Starting next month, employees will have to pay to use the company lot.
Yes. Ten dollars a day. A lot of people are upset.
I can understand why. I drive in every day, so that's about two hundred a month.
Management says it's to encourage people to take public transportation. They're also offering fifty percent off monthly bus passes.
The bus from my neighborhood takes over an hour.
Have you thought about carpooling? Cars with three or more employees can park for free.
Actually, Carmen lives near me. I'll ask her if she'd be interested.
Good idea. You can sign up through the HR website.

questions.q: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
questions.explain: Cô ấy hỏi: "did you see the email about the new parking policy?" – chính sách đỗ xe mới.

questions.q: What does the woman mean when she says, "The bus from my neighborhood takes over an hour"?
options: She is often late for work
Taking the bus is not practical for her
She wants to move closer to work
The bus discount is too small
questions.explain: Khi được gợi ý đi xe buýt giảm giá, cô ấy nói xe buýt mất hơn một tiếng – ngụ ý đi xe buýt không phù hợp với cô.

questions.q: What will the woman probably do next?
questions.explain: Cô ấy nói: "Carmen lives near me. I'll ask her" – sẽ hỏi đồng nghiệp về việc đi chung xe.

lines.text: Thanks for staying late, everyone. I'd like to talk about adding a seasonal item to the menu for autumn.
What about pumpkin bread? Customers kept asking for it last year.
We'd need a new supplier for pumpkin, though. Our current one only sells it frozen.
Fresh would definitely taste better. Ethan, could you get a few quotes from local farms?
Sure. There's a farm in Millbrook that delivers twice a week.
And I could try out a few recipes this weekend, if I can use the kitchen on Sunday.
That's fine. Let's have everyone taste them on Monday morning before we open.

questions.q: Where do the speakers most likely work?
questions.explain: Họ bàn thêm món theo mùa vào thực đơn như "pumpkin bread" và nói "before we open" – họ làm ở tiệm bánh.

questions.q: What problem does Ethan mention?
options: The current supplier does not offer a fresh ingredient
questions.explain: Ethan nói: "Our current one only sells it frozen" – nhà cung cấp hiện tại chỉ bán bí đỏ đông lạnh.

questions.q: What does Noah offer to do?
options: Work at the counter on Sunday
questions.explain: Noah nói: "I could try out a few recipes this weekend" – thử nghiệm công thức.

graphic.title: Customer Survey: Reasons for Contacting Support

lines.text: Wendy, have you had a chance to look at the results of the support survey?
I have. I wasn't surprised that login problems were at the top. But we're redesigning that page anyway.
Right, that project's already scheduled for next quarter. What about the second-largest category?
That's the one I want to focus on now. Most of those questions could be answered on our website if the information were clearer.
So you're thinking of a better FAQ section?
Exactly. And maybe a short video explaining how charges appear on monthly statements.
I like that. Could you write up a proposal by next Wednesday? I'll present it at the department meeting.

questions.q: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
questions.explain: Anh ấy hỏi: "have you had a chance to look at the results of the support survey?"

questions.q: Why is the woman not focusing on login problems?
options: The IT team has fixed it
Work on that issue is already planned
questions.explain: Cô ấy nói: "we're redesigning that page anyway" và anh ấy xác nhận dự án "already scheduled for next quarter".

questions.q: Look at the graphic. Which category does the woman want to focus on?
questions.explain: Cô ấy muốn tập trung vào "the second-largest category" – theo bảng là Billing questions (27%); cô ấy cũng nhắc đến cách tính phí trên hóa đơn.

lines.text: Leo, Mia, about the cover story for the March issue: the interview with the architect Daniel Cho fell through.
Oh no. What happened?
His publicist said he's too busy with a project in Seoul. So we need a replacement, and quickly.
What about my piece on urban rooftop gardens? It's finished, and the photographer has already taken pictures.
That's a good fit for a spring issue, too.
I agree. Mia, it's a bit short for a cover story, though. Could you add another eight hundred words by Friday?
Sure. I could include interviews with a couple of the garden owners.
I'll contact the photographer about a cover shot, then.

questions.q: Where do the speakers most likely work?
questions.explain: Họ bàn về "the cover story for the March issue" – bài trang bìa của số tháng Ba, nên họ làm ở tạp chí.

questions.q: Why does the cover story need to be replaced?
options: A planned interview will not happen
questions.explain: Vanessa nói: "the interview with the architect Daniel Cho fell through" – buổi phỏng vấn bị hủy.

questions.q: What is Mia asked to do?
questions.explain: Vanessa nói: "Could you add another eight hundred words by Friday?" – viết thêm cho bài dài hơn.

lines.text: Hi, I'd like to set up a regular weekly grocery delivery. I just moved to the area.
Welcome! Which neighborhood are you in?
I'm on Maple Avenue, near the Hillcrest library.
Ah, then you're actually just inside the Eastside zone. The boundary is the library itself.
Oh, that's good news. The grocery store near my old place charged a lot for delivery, so I was a little worried.
And if you sign up for weekly deliveries, you'll get ten percent off your first order.
Great. Is there a minimum order amount?
Yes, thirty dollars. You can set everything up on our app. I'll text you a link now.

questions.q: Why is the woman calling?
options: To complain about a late order
questions.explain: Cô ấy nói: "I'd like to set up a regular weekly grocery delivery".

questions.q: What does the man say the woman will receive?
options: A reduced price on her first order
questions.explain: Anh ấy nói: "you'll get ten percent off your first order" – giảm giá đơn đầu tiên.

questions.q: Look at the graphic. How much will the woman most likely pay for each delivery?
questions.explain: Dù gần thư viện Hillcrest, anh ấy nói: "you're actually just inside the Eastside zone" – theo bảng, khu Eastside phí $4.
